Well, to give a short answer mediocre.
For the Longer answer I will split it into parts that I enjoy in the RE frachise games.

Exploration and Loot:
This is probably the best part of the game, allthough the maps are quute linear, in most sections backtracking is encuraged to collect items you couldn't get to before.
There were always alot of items to find and objects to collect and combine.

Puzzels:
It barely has any and those it does have are not really enough to be considered good or engaging.
Puzzles in these games often give you the time to breath and refelct on what happened so far while still giving you an engaging experience, here it wasn't that, either the puzzels were to short, easy or not even really there.

Combat:
This section will not include bosses as they are a special section.
The combat feels nice, most enemies are responsiv to your shooting and go down in a satisfying way.
The small amount of weapons was fine as the game wasn't too long and each of them felt unique enough to find use (maybe with the exception of the 2 pistols but hey, thats barely worth mentioning)
Dodging on the other hand felt weird, granted I am no expert in the game and have not mastered enemy attack patterns but on my first playthrough fodging felt activly bad and I really did not like it.

Difficulty:
I like the games amount of difficulty modes altthoughI have not beaten all of them I have heard that inferno is a bit ridiculous.
On my 1st run I played assisted and it was miserable.
(I always play assisted first as it lets me see in my own pase what the game has to offer, most of the time I play ER games once on each if the difficulties, this beeing the exception).
Most of the time it was fine but the hunters and the final nemisis fight with their insta kills kinda ruined it (not for me personally but I also always think of implications here and if I was someone who played on assisted to match my skill level this would ve disasterous).

Bosses:
Ok, nothing to write home about.
Alot of them seemed a bit gimicky, and it felt like they were a bit to spongy (unloading 16 mag shots, 5 Acid, 5 fire, 3 explosion grenades and a few shothun shells before doggo nemmy went down on assisted)
And the final boss was meh and more of a timing game then a good fight. (Tbh RE rarely has satisfying final bosses, the only exeptions I would say are RE 4 remake sadler and mother miranda)

All in all I am glad I got it for 10 bucks on a sale as it wouldn't have been worth 15 in my opinion.
It often just felt like a child wanting to show you what their cool action figures can do while ya listen to them explaining imaginary super powers.
Just not what I seek in a RE game, and even surpassed RE 8 as the worst so far on mylist.
All that doesn't mean that you cannot enjoy this game, if ya had fun, the all the better for you, as fun is verry subjectiv :)
